Maya R: Quick sync Hi team I pushed a proposal to standardize a few phrasing points across quickstarts and SDK snippets: 1) always show the full parameter name in inline comments but keep example calls short, 2) prefer "endpoint" (no suffix) when showing SDK usage but use "endpoint URL" in network/ops docs, and 3) prefer open-form "model serving" (no hyphen) in prose but hyphenate in compound adjectives like "model-serving runtime". Thoughts?
Owen T: Love the nuance. +1 on showcasing short calls but annotating the param. Example: `// endpoint: https://...` above `client.call({ endpoint, model: 'redwood-1' })`. Keeps snippets clean for readers copying code.
Priya G: Agree with wording split. One ask: add a short note in the migration guide where we changed CLI flag `--endpoint-url` -> `--endpoint` so users know both map to same config. That reduced confusion during the last release.
Maya R: Good catch. I'll add a 2-line migration note and a sample bash mapping: `````bash
# old
export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT_URL=https://api.redwood.ai
# new
export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT=https://api.redwood.ai
`````
Sam L: Small nit: ensure the glossary has entries for both "endpoint" and "endpoint URL" and cross-link. Also check the translations pipeline for i18n so we don't create duplicate strings.
docs-bot: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399 by @mayar (files: quickstart/sdk-usage.md, migration/flags.md, glossary.md)
Maya R: @Priya G could you review the migration wording? @Sam L can you skim the glossary blurb? I'll keep examples minimal and add inline comments.
Priya G: Happy to review later today. Add the mapping snippet and a one-liner: "Both env vars are accepted for now; `REDWOOD_ENDPOINT` is preferred going forward."
Sam L: Will check glossary and confirm i18n keys aren't duplicated.
Owen T: Suggest adding one combined SDK snippet showing both `endpoint` short call and an explicit `endpoint` variable example with comment explaining when to use a full URL.
Maya R: Will add that. Plan: push update, ping reviewers, then merge once migration note + glossary crosslink are in. Action items below.
Maya R: Action items:
- Maya: update PR with migration note + combined SDK snippet
- Priya: review migration wording
- Sam: review glossary + i18n keys
- Owen: optional snippet tidy
